title: the rule decides a conflict the classes decide
line: a state death index dating the death the 11th, primary information from the record of the death itself, against the file's bare claim of the 10th: the rule resolves it as soon as the owner accepts the index, through the owner's own resolve, its reason in words from the classes and recorded as acting for the owner, the event carrying the 11th and the 10th kept as the file says it; reconsider keeps it while it holds; the owner's rejection of the index's statement takes it back there and then (the event's 10th restored from the resolution's own record of it), the owner's accept of it again resolves it again there and then, each told in the command's own answer, and once the owner reopens it the conflict is the owner's for good; the written conclusion prints the open question under its id, naming the record by its number and saying the conflict is the owner's once reopened
